Author: Saumitra Dayal Singh

High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 35
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 9503 of 2023
Applicant :- Nasir And 3 Others

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Araf Khan,Sonakshi Arora
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Saumitra Dayal Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants and the learned AGA for the State.

2. Present application has been filed to quash the summoning order dated 07.12.2021 passed by the Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No. 3 Aligarh in Complaint Case No. 934 of 2021 under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Jawan, District Aligarh and to quash the proceedings of the aforesaid case.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No. 3 Aligarh
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
3. Relying on the earlier order of the coordinate bench of this Court passed in Application U/S 482 No. 1230 of 2022 (Smt. Geeta and 4 Others Vs. State of U.P. and Another) and the settled position in law that a Magistrate may not entertain complaint against an accused residing outside his territorial jurisdiction except after conducting enquiry under Section 202(1) Cr.P.C., it has been submitted,
summoning order suffers from inherent defect inasmuch as no such enquiry was ever conducted.
Nasir And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/163684989/
1 4.

entities.text: Geeta and 4 Others Vs. State of U.P. and Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Nasir And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Even otherwise, it has been submitted, a simple matrimonial discord has been given the colour of criminal prosecution for collateral purpose.
5. Prima facie, contentions advanced appear to be correct inasmuch as the applicants are resident of district Bulandshahr whereas the complaint has been lodged at Aligarh.
The impugned order as annexed and the statements recorded during investigation do not bring out any fact circumstance as may indicate that any enquiry had been made.

6. In view of the fact that the complaint is at preliminary stage and further in view of the fact that suggestion of mediation has been declined, no useful purpose may be served in keeping the application pending or calling for counter affidavit at this stage.
7. Accordingly, the summoning order dated 07.12.2021 is set aside and the matter is remitted to the learned Magistrate to pass fresh order in accordance with law.
8. Present application is accordingly disposed of.

Order Date :- 22.3.2023 Faraz  Nasir And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/163684989/
